risk.rationale: Verified evidence confirms a complete account takeover chain for d.yilmaz@aegean.edu: phishing email from aegean-edu.co delivered (F7) and link clicked (F6); password spray against 66 accounts followed by successful sign-in as this user (F9); MFA fatigue with 7 denied pushes then 1 approval from 185.220.101.7 (F5); impossible travel and sign-ins from suspicious hosting ASN BulwarkHost Ltd outside baseline (F2, F4); bulk SIS access (38 events in 60 min from 185.220.101.7) indicating data access (F1); and an API-created inbox forwarding rule to an external Gmail address for persistence/exfiltration (F8). Multiple high-confidence CONFIRMED findings (0.7–0.9) with no conflicting evidence or explained-away signals. This is a confirmed account takeover chain requiring immediate containment.
